canonical_identity.problem: the control plane lacks a deterministic live repository snapshot that joins queue claims runs returns and readiness workers currently reconstruct state through repeated ad hoc reads and control room fixture semantics do not prove live wiring.
acceptance: concurrent repository change is detected as drift rather than silently mixing epochs
control room and allocator can consume the snapshot as candidate input without changing authority
one invocation deterministically emits a joined snapshot from current repository state without mutating queue or authority
repeated invocation on the same source head is byte-stable
snapshot classifies ready claimed started returned stale and blocked work and records source refs and source heads
